# ASTalyzer main menu 
id: "prismata.astalyzer.menu.main"
version: 0.2.0
kind: menu
description: Main PCMS-2026 menu for ASTalyzer tools.

layout:
  type: list
  title: ASTalyzer — Prompt & Code Analysis Tools

items:
  - id: "prismata.astalyzer.menu-item.analyze-prompt-ticcseo"
    label: Analyze Prompt (TICCSEO AST)
    group: analysis
    action:
      type: udi-capability
      capability_id: "prismata.astalyzer.capability.analyze-prompt-ticcseo"
    hints:
      short: Parse a raw prompt into TICCSEO AST.
      long: >
        Takes a raw prompt string, parses it into Task, Input, Context,
        Constraints, Style, Examples, and Output Format, and returns a
        structured AST object conforming to prompt-ast-ticcseo schema.

  - id: "prismata.astalyzer.menu-item.scan-api-recursive"
    label: Scan Folder for APIs (Recursive)
    group: analysis
    action: "prismata.astalyzer.menu.scan"
